description: Explain the site audit to the site's owner, in plain words, the most serious first
---

Read AUDIT.html (the site's audit) and KNOWN-ISSUES.md, then explain them to the site's owner, who is
not technical. Change no file.

- Start with how many things are wrong, and how many are major.
- Then each finding, the most serious first: what a visitor (or a search engine) meets, why it matters
  to the business, who usually fixes it (the web developer, the hosting company, whoever writes the
  content) and how big a job it is.
- End with the three to do first, and why those three.

Use the audit's own words for the facts; add no finding it does not have.
